hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card UI and reasonable categorical palette, but the circle pack is clipped at the bottom (orange group partially hidden), and dense bundled edges rendered as dark hairlines create visual noise that obscures the hierarchy rather than revealing it.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Encoding is structurally honest: scaleSqrt used correctly for force node sizing and sunburst radii, d3.pack handles area encoding internally, and key functions (d => d.data.id) are present on all data joins; no zero-baseline violations, dual-axis risk, or line.defined gaps apply to these layout types.
flags: Mid-Flight RAF Leak: tickLinks RAF loop inside renderNodes is a local variable with no external cancel handle; rapid layout switching leaves orphaned RAF loops calling drawLinks/drawHierarchyLinks concurrently
Uncancellable d3.timeout: the dur+20ms link-redraw callback is not stored or cleared on switchLayout, so it fires and overwrites posMap-derived state after the new layout has already rendered
No Touch Filtering: force-drag and hover listeners attach no event.sourceEvent or ctrlKey filter, leaving mouse and touch events unguarded on mobile
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Core throttling patterns are solid (slider and hover use RAF guards, force-sim tick uses a ticking flag, switchLayout calls .interrupt()), but the local-scoped tickLinks RAF loop and non-cancellable d3.timeout create overlapping draw calls and a genuine race when layouts are switched mid-transition.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Group structure is legible (6–7 distinct hues, spatially separated clusters) but the 300-edge bundle converges into a dense central tangle that is nearly unreadable, the bottom group is cropped out of the viewport, and the 7-layout control bar adds interface overhead without a clear entry point for the viewer.
